text: …　あそんでく　ひまが　ない

structure.jp: …　あそんでく　ひまが

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: いく after a て-form verb says you do the action and then go on your way; でく is the short spoken form of でいく. あそんでく = 'play a bit and then go'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. あそんでく ひま = 'time to stop and play'.
